unclassified.source_text: To earn the BSW degree, students must successfully complete a total of 128 units, with 60 units specifically allocated to courses in the social work major.
unclassified.why: This states an overall degree/major total unit count rather than a bounded selection, distribution split, reuse rule, sequence, or manual-review item; no family covers a bare total-degree-unit requirement.

unclassified.source_text: Students must also demonstrate a strong commitment to ethical practice and professionalism grounded in principles of wellness, resilience and reflective practice.
unclassified.why: This is an aspirational/qualitative statement about character and professionalism, not a checkable course, unit, sequencing, or admission requirement.
